title: AI PACs spent millions trying to shape Congress — here’s how they fared

thread_text:
1. The Money Didn't Work

AI PACs spent millions backing candidates. Most of those endorsed candidates lost their races anyway.

2. Lobbying War Chest Built

The AI industry amassed a record lobbying fund this cycle. They wanted influence, not just ads.

3. Your District Is Next

These same PACs are already planning ad buys for the next election cycle. Your representative's race may be targeted.

4. Check the Funders

Look up who financed your representative's campaign. Follow the money before the next ad hits your feed.

5. Ask Them Directly

Call your representative's office and ask if they took AI PAC money. Then tell us what they said.

instagram.caption:
AI political action committees spent millions backing candidates for Congress this cycle, and most of the candidates they endorsed still lost their races. 💸

The AI industry built a record lobbying war chest to buy influence, not just airtime.

Those same PACs are already planning ad buys for the next election cycle, and your district could be a target.

So content creators and publishers may soon see these ads flooding their feeds and wonder who's really paying for them.

Before the next ad hits your feed, look up who funded your representative's race. 🕵️ Then tell us: did your rep take AI PAC money? 📞
